WITH failure_conditions AS (
    SELECT 
        sc.showcasereg AS showcase_id
    FROM 
        showcases sc
    WHERE 
        sc.airtightness < 90
    UNION
    SELECT 
        er.showcaseref AS showcase_id
    FROM 
        environmentalreadingscore er
    WHERE 
        er.tempc < 18 OR er.tempc > 22
    UNION
    SELECT 
        er.showcaseref AS showcase_id
    FROM 
        environmentalreadingscore er
    WHERE 
        er.relhumidity < 40 OR er.relhumidity > 60
    UNION
    SELECT 
        er.showcaseref AS showcase_id
    FROM 
        environmentalreadingscore er
    WHERE 
        er.airpresshpa < 950 OR er.airpresshpa > 1050
)
SELECT 
    DISTINCT showcase_id
FROM 
    failure_conditions;
